steps: Peel and coarsely grate 200 g of beet; squeeze out excess moisture using a clean cloth.
In a large bowl, mash the cooked lentils with a fork until mostly smooth.
Add the grated beet, minced garlic, cumin, lemon juice, oat flour, and egg to the bowl.
Stir firmly until a uniform dough forms that holds its shape when pressed.
Divide into 16 equal portions and flatten each into a round patty about 1 cm thick.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, 180 °C (350 °F).
Cook the patties in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until firm and golden.
Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel and cool slightly before serving.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for 1 month.
